objs.name: document
objs.description: A controlled artifact subject to creation, editing, release, distribution, and archiving in the P&R management system.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of document such as Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, or Work Instruction.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of document in lifecycle: Editing, Released, or Out of Force.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Sequential version number of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date when the document version becomes effective.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date when the document validity expires.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: System identifier for the document type.

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: The actual text or data stored in the document.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Area of validity or applicability of the document.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document supplement released with the main document and subject to the same release cycle.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Sequential version number of the attachment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state in the release process.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: A document supplement not subject to the release cycle or dual control principle, released directly via properties switches.

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: Supplementary information such as instructions, photos, or screenshots.

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person with defined roles and authorizations in the system.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role such as Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator, or Reader.

attributes.name: user_group
attributes.description: Group membership for authorization and distribution purposes.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposed amendment to an existing document managed independently without affecting version history.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: State of the proposal: Pending, Scheduled, or Completed.

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated request to review and confirm continued validity of a document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: State of the request: Pending or Processed.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to invalidate and archive a document that no longer has validity.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: State of the request: Pending or Processed.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to re-validate and restore a previously archived and invalidated document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: State of the request: Pending or Processed.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A process step in the document lifecycle requiring task completion and signature.

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: Stage in workflow: Creator, Review, or Release.

attributes.name: signature
attributes.description: Electronic signature applied by workflow participant.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A set of users and user groups assigned to receive document distribution or acknowledgement requests.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Method of distribution: Email notification or Acknowledgement request.

objs.name: archive
objs.description: A repository for invalidated documents with restricted access retained for a defined period.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period for which documents are retained before physical deletion.

attributes.name: archive_group
attributes.description: User group with read access to archived documents.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Attach a new document object to the system with selection of document type and optional template.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Type selected for the new document.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Modify the document content using the integrated editing client and Office components.

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Update document properties and attributes such as references, IT applications, and validity scope.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert the edited document to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: create_workflow
evts.description: Initiate the three-step release workflow consisting of Creator, Review, and Release stages.

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Apply electronic signature as workflow participant in Creator, Review, or Release step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Check document content and properties for technical and formal correctness.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Approve and publish a document making it visible to assigned readers.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically make a released document visible to readers on the system.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Create a new version of a released document with retained data and possible modifications.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark an attachment as no longer relevant in a new document version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Propose an amendment to an existing document without affecting version history or content.

evts.name: process_change_proposal
evts.description: Review and implement a scheduled change proposal creating a new document version.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Confirm continued validity of a document and update the Valid Until date.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: System-generated request triggered 30 days before document validity expires.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Submit a request to invalidate and archive a document with no additional validity.

evts.name: override_document
evts.description: Declare a document Out of Force and archive it with all authorizations revoked except archive group.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Submit a request to re-validate a previously archived and invalidated document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Restore an archived document to active status with retained metadata and properties.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Define group and person-specific read and change permissions for a document.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Notify assigned users and user groups by email when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Send workflow task to distribution list members requesting active confirmation of document receipt.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Actively acknowledge receipt and understanding of a distributed document.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Create a language-dependent version of a released document for authorized readers.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Approve and publish a translated document version in workflow.

evts.name: access_document
evts.description: View an approved document from the reader dashboard or document list.

evts.name: generate_report
evts.description: Create role-specific evaluation report on document status, workflows, or acknowledgements.

o2o.description: A document may have one or more attachments released with the main document.
A document may have one or more additional information supplements not subject to release cycle.
A change proposal is always linked to and proposed for a specific document.
A document may reference or be linked to other documents.
A validity extension request is linked to the document being reviewed for continued validity.
An override request is created for a specific document to be invalidated.
A reactivation request targets a specific archived document to be restored.
A document has a distribution list defining authorized users and groups for access and notification.
A document follows a defined workflow through Creator, Review, and Release stages.
An invalidated document is archived with access restricted to the archive group.
Users may have relationships such as author to co-author or reviewer assignments.
Archived attachments associated with a document are reactivated when the document is reactivated.

A user performs document creation.
Document content is modified by this action.

Document properties and attributes are updated.

A document is converted to PDF format.
A workflow is initiated for a document.
An author or co-author initiates the workflow.
A document is signed electronically during workflow.

Document content and properties are reviewed.

A released document is published.

A change proposal is processed and implemented.

A document's validity is extended.

An override request is created for a document.
